children: The Singapore dollar strengthens slightly against its U.S. counterpart on likely technical recovery after falling to a more than one-week low on Friday. Overbought conditions for the U.S. dollar-Singapore dollar pair suggest any advance for next 24 hours could be contained within a 1.2725-1.2765 range, two members of UOB Global Economics & Markets Research say in a report. Even if the U.S. dollar were to rise above S$1.2765, major resistance at S$1.2780 is unlikely to come into view, the members add. The U.S. dollar is 0.1% lower at S$1.2735 after touching S$1.2753 on Friday, its highest intraday level since Aug. 19, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
